topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe this. I was just checking my email, and there it was—an update from the college, stating they found my application essay so exceptional, they've decided to use it as a model for future applicants. At first, a rush of pride. But then, the questions swarm. Did they do this before? How many people will see it? What if it’s not as good as I thought? I need to know if this changes anything, if it’s seen as too forward, or worse, not enough. I have to reach out to them, find out what this really means. My whole application, everything I've worked for, feels hanging by a thread now.
